name: dma-insights
description: The six Digital Maturity Assessment skills, sixteen DMA agents and the remote DMA Insights MCP connector (33 tools) as one installable unit. All 53 mapped surfaces route to per-page producers, an adversarial finding-challenger, a page-consolidator and a qa-overseer that writes the findings memory; hooks refuse a doomed submit before the network sees it. Ships gates AG-11/12 and CG-26 through CG-31, per-surface anti-pattern rulebooks with enrichment pathways, and the shared platform-fit engine.

mcp_base_url.title: Connector base URL
mcp_base_url.description: Cloud Run URL of the deployed dmai-mcp service, no trailing slash. Override only for a staging deployment.

mcp_path_token.title: Connector path token
mcp_path_token.description: The capability-path segment the connector is mounted under. Read it from Secret Manager: gcloud secrets versions access latest --secret=dmai-mcp-path-token. Never commit it; it is stored in your OS keychain, not in settings.json.

repo_root.title: DMA Insights repo checkout
repo_root.description: Optional. Absolute path to a checkout of the DMA Insights repository. Only skills/dma-surface-production/scripts/precheck_gates.py uses it, to import the connector's own gate modules from apps/mcp rather than re-implementing them. Leave empty and precheck_gates.py reports which gates it could not run instead of guessing.
